And then you marvel, surprised that they rebel, you fucking fools.

The shitshow that has been made out of the Charlie Kirk murder is, straight up, an orgy of idolatry.

Instead of responding to his murder humanly, honestly, with love and empathy (or compassion, as he would have us say,) you have made a mockery of the man and his work by co-opting them to promote your own egotistic views.

Shame on all of you.

I haven't seen genuine, heartfelt grief or mourning in any of the shit that's been spewed online.

No wonder, because the principal trait of genuine grief and mourning is silence.

You all sound like a pack of wild dogs barking.

People have asked me where my sympathy, empathy, compassion are because I've expressed no grief or mourning for Charlie.

That's because the environment that's developed has nothing to do with grief or mourning or the human being himself.

It's all been politicized and it's being weaponized, and you're all falling for it.

Grief and mourning are among the most intimately personal, vulnerable, and sensitive experiences we ever go through.

Fuck if I'm going to bring mine out in the company of barking dogs.

comment.name: Millard J Melnyk
comment.body:
@John Spencer, regarding your article, “The U.N. Genocide Report Against Israel Is an Assault on Critical Thinking“, at https://spencerguard.substack.com/p/the-un-genocide-report-against-israel

——————————————

Critical thinking? After reading your hit piece, I’m left with the same but mightily strengthened impression I’ve gotten every time I read one of your pieces.

No one who makes such fallacious arguments has the right to opine about critical thinking.

Your points sort into two categories: 

Objections that attempt to justify what USrael has done in Gaza. All of these implicitly confirm that USrael has committed these abominable acts. 

Faulting relatively insignificant items in the report, without substantiation—points which, even if you were right, would have no material bearing on the charge of genocide.

I’ve always admired your writing as masterful works of deceptive bullshit. This one was a typical example of narcissistic focus-shifting away from Israel’s now globally-denounced crimes, trying to spotlight Hamas as the Big Demon Enemy under the delusional assumption that it poses an existential threat to Israel. 

Funny thing, that—what’s your evidence that demonstrates the material success of Hamas to actually, physically threaten the existence of Israel? A few mortars leveling a building here or there, killing one or more dozens of Israelis (if that—after all, this is war, right?) compared to hundreds of thousands butchered and 80% of Gaza’s developed territory now in shambles… and HAMAS IS THE EXISTENTIAL THREAT? 

Dude, please. If that’s really what you think, you’re suffering from a psychotic level of paranoid delusion. You seem more cogent than that, so I’m forced into the alternative: you’re just bursting at the seams with nonsense pigshit.

Every accusation made by Zionist toadies like you to the effect that Hamas existentially threatens Israel has been predicated on Hamas’ intent to exterminate Israel—not on even the slightest bit of evidence that it’s either capable of doing so or has even come close to beginning any such extermination.

But you don’t stop there: you turn it around for Israel, despite overwhelming evidence of intent—I mean, how much bloodshed and destruction can your denial withstand? Will 90% of Gaza destroyed prove genocidal intent? 95%? Or will you still be dandying up your woefully pubescent  point—Israel doesn’t mean to!—with yet more cleverly arranged word salad even once the utter destruction of Gaza and the Palestinians that called it home is absolute?

Or maybe that’s the strategy: hold out in juvenile, foot-stomping denial that you well know is pigshit until the job is done and then, “WOOPS! Oh-so-sorry, we didn’t realize we were committing genocide. Our bad!”

Fucking hypocrites.

As I was saying, you condemn Hamas based on intent, but then—despite incontrovertible, consistent evidence, both in fact of massive bloodshed and destruction since the Nakba and in the clear, explicit statements of intent of not just the current leaders you try to exceptionalize and trivialize, but every “leader” since Herzl—you pooh-pooh it all and claim “no evidence of intent”.

Damn, dude. You seem to expect us to be as idiotic as your arguments are to swallow that shit.

For example, you made a big deal out of the “Hamas’s tens of thousands of fighters” to project this BS about “existential threat”, which might seem plausible to some until they see it quantified.

Second, there is no discussion of Hamas’s military disposition, composition, or strength. The report makes no mention of Hamas’s tens of thousands of fighters, its organized brigades and battalions, or its command and control systems. Readers are left with the impression that there is no military presence in Gaza at all, which of course makes any Israeli strike appear inherently illegitimate.

No, fool. No one thinks there is “no military presence in Gaza at all”. You’re hallucinating. But when we see that current estimates put able-bodied Hamas fighters at around 25,000 in January and maybe 40,000 as of August—according to Israel’s own estimates, which are inflated; a more accurate estimate would be 15,000 - 20,000—and compare that to Israel’s 290,000 active and mobilized reserves and however many hundreds or thousands of GenoTourists revolve through the ranks, it turns your “argument” into a pathetic joke.

And note that Israel’s efforts have effectively doubled or even tripled (according to its own figures) the number of Hamas fighters since summer 2024, when they numbered between 9,000 - 15,000.

The harder you try to climb out of your denialist shitpit, the deeper you dig it. 

Here’s a little critical thinking for you:

Not all the arguments in the world over the words you use to describe a reality make a shit bit of difference to the reality. 

Quibbling about words only trivializes the reality. Well done! 🤣

If you want to make your “arguments” (poor excuses, actually) credible, use specifics and facts instead of unsubstantiated or completely false generalities and allusions.

If you hold Hamas up to a set of requirements and standards, hold Israel to the same.

Supposedly, there’s a German saying that goes, if 9 people sit down to eat with 1 Nazi, 10 Nazis are seated at the table.

Of, if you prefer, a person is known by the company they choose.

Those who dine, party, and sleep with genocidists are, themselves, genocidists. 

Here’s my summation of your article:

The good man out of the good treasure of his heart brings forth what is good; and the evil man out of the evil treasure brings forth what is evil; for his mouth speaks from that which fills his heart.

That’s all the time I have for this particular turd of Zionist pandering. I only took this much time with it to make clear that I’m not fucking around or merely name calling when I say, “STFU, you perverted genocidist.”

https://spencerguard.substack.com/p/the-un-genocide-report-against-israel
